Built for ownership

Your ideas deserve network scale.

Packages
Choose your build

From creator site to private network.

Three clear production levels, each built around ownership. Start with the platform that matches how you publish now — and where you want to grow.

Creator Launch
$5,800

Professional streaming-style website using YouTube video hosting.

  • Cinematic network-style website design
  • Custom YouTube video player layout
  • YouTube videos embedded without suggested videos
  • Streaming-style layout (like Netflix rows)
  • Mobile optimized
  • Brand colors & typography setup
  • Revision rounds included
  • Built on WordPress + Divi
  • Tutorial walkthrough after launch
Best forCreators who already host videos on YouTube and want a premium presentation layer.
Most Popular
Studio Pro
$10,800

Professional video platform with your own hosted player.

  • Everything in Creator Launch
  • Custom Video Player
  • Video hosting via Bunny.net
  • Video delivery powered by Presto Player
  • No ads or platform branding
  • Faster streaming performance
  • Advanced video playback controls
Best forCreators who want their own professional streaming environment without relying on YouTube.
Network Platform
$18,800

A full content platform with private member access.

  • Everything in Studio Pro
  • Custom Membership Website
  • Private login portal
  • Member-only video libraries
  • Paid subscriber access capability
  • Content protection
  • Structured video categories
  • Scalable platform structure
Best forCreators launching their own streaming platform, academy, or subscription content network.

Payment schedule: 50% deposit / 25% midway / 25% final via PayPal.

Process
How it works

Four steps to going live.

A collaborative build process with clear checkpoints — from the first conversation through delivery.

01

Book Your Consultation

We start with a call to understand your goals and determine the right setup for your platform.

02

Submit Your Materials

Provide your content, links, and assets so we can begin building your platform.

03

Build & Review

We build your site with you, review it together, and make revisions based on your package.

04

Launch Your Platform

Your site is finalized, delivered, and ready for you to manage and grow.

Creative roots

Built on experience, not guesswork.
